summary.root_cause_text: payment_provider_url was changed to internal://payments-v2 (not in recent_changes; seen only in config log), so orders were processed without payment.
recommended: Find out who changed the provider URL to payments-v2 without a recorded change, and why it silently failed.
Add alerting on payment gap and config audit logging.

No log lines at INFO or above from payment.

1 matching lines (of the last 5000). Most frequent messages:
  1x [INFO] config: config reloaded
Most recent 1 lines:
{"ts": "2026-10-30T16:41:17.916+00:00", "level": "INFO", "component": "config", "msg": "config reloaded", "changed": {"payment_provider_url": {"old": "internal://payments-v1", "new": "internal://payments-v2"}}}
No log lines at INFO or above from worker.

I notice the provider got changed to v2 without that being listed in the changes — that looks unintentional, so I should revert it back to v1 and just fix it directly rather than digging through pipeline logs.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
